# Private Morocco Transfers (privatemoroccotransfers.com)

> Guaranteed fixed-price private transfers, airport pickups, and chauffeur services across Morocco.

## About the Service
- **Service Name:** Private Morocco Transfers
- [Official Website](https://www.privatemoroccotransfers.com)
- **WhatsApp Booking & Support:** +212 760 426 269 (Instant confirmation)
- **Fleet:** Modern Comfort Sedans (1–4 pax), Spacious Vans (5–7 pax, Mercedes Vito/V-Class), and VIP Minibuses (8–14 pax, Mercedes Sprinter).
- **Pricing Policy:** Flat rate per vehicle (never per person). All tolls, vehicle fuel, parking, and luggage handling are 100% included.
- **Deposit & Payment:** Zero prepayment or deposit needed for bookings of €300 (3,300 MAD) or less. Pay directly to the driver on arrival in EUR, MAD, USD, or GBP. 30% confirmation deposit for bookings exceeding €300.
- **Discounts:** 10% discount on all round-trip return transfers.
- **Airport Pickups:** Free flight delay monitoring and 45-minute terminal waiting with Meet & Greet name sign included.
- **Child Seats:** Certified infant car seats and child boosters provided free upon request.

## Common Travel Questions
- **Is there a train from Marrakech to Agadir?** No. Morocco's railway ends at Marrakech. Options are CTM or Supratours coaches (about 3 to 3.5 hours between bus stations), shared grand taxis, or a private transfer (about 3 hours door to door, fixed price per vehicle). See [Marrakech to Agadir](https://www.privatemoroccotransfers.com/transfers/marrakech-to-agadir).
- **Is there a train from Marrakech to Essaouira?** No. Supratours and CTM coaches take about 3 hours; a private transfer takes about 2h30 door to door, with an optional argan oil cooperative stop. See [Marrakech to Essaouira](https://www.privatemoroccotransfers.com/transfers/marrakech-to-essaouira).
- **Train or private driver from Casablanca to Marrakech?** The ONCF train from Casa-Voyageurs takes a little under 3 hours; the Al Boraq high-speed line does not reach Marrakech yet (extension planned for around 2029). From Casablanca Airport (CMN) the train needs a change in Casablanca; a private transfer goes straight to your hotel or riad in about 3 hours. See [Casablanca Airport to Marrakech](https://www.privatemoroccotransfers.com/transfers/casablanca-airport-to-marrakech).
- **How much is a taxi between Moroccan cities?** Private Morocco Transfers charges one fixed price per vehicle (not per person), including fuel, tolls and luggage: comfort sedan (1 to 4 passengers), Mercedes Vito-class van (5 to 7) or minibus (8 to 14). No meter and no haggling.
- **Do you offer VIP airport transfers?** Yes, at Marrakech (RAK), Casablanca (CMN), Agadir (AGA), Fes (FEZ) and Tangier (TNG): meet and greet inside arrivals with a name sign, flight tracking and 45 minutes of free waiting. See [Airport transfers](https://www.privatemoroccotransfers.com/airport-transfers).
